title: OccWorld: Learning a 3D Occupancy World Model for Autonomous Driving
caption: Fig. 3: Illustration of the proposed modules. (a) We use CNNs to encode the 3D occupancy and perform vector quantization to obtain discrete tokens using a learnable codebook [42]. We then employ a decoder to reconstruct the input 3D occupancy us- ing the quantized tokens and train the autoencoder and codebook simultaneously. (b) As each scene is represented by world tokens, we adopt spatial mixing to model their intrinsic dependencies and obtain multi-scale world tokens to capture multi-level infor- mation. We perform spatial-wise temporal causal self-attention at each level to forecast the next scene and employ a U-net structure to aggregate multi-scale predictions.
